title: ipu-as check --json, version 1
description: What `ipu-as check --json` (or `--json-version 1`) prints: every problem found in the source, as a bare array. See check-json.md.

line.description: First line of the span, from 0.

column.description: First column of the span, from 0.

end_line.description: Line the span ends on, from 0.

end_column.description: Column the span ends before, from 0.

message.description: What is wrong. Its wording is part of the contract: the extension compares messages.

stage.description: Which step found it: Jinja rendering, parsing, encoding, or the checker itself failing.

approximate.description: True when the position could not be pinned down exactly.
